analysis_type: follow-up analysis of previously observed 22-image candidates; selection rules fixed before this comparison computation

subsets.all: all 8 sampled candidates per image; retain duplicates and failures
subsets.quality_pass: only saved quality_usable candidates; greedy reference unchanged; report coverage and fail if empty

selection_ties: exact reward equality; average utility over all top-reward candidates, the exact expectation of uniform tie-breaking
random: exact expectation: mean over eligible sampled candidates; duplicates retain original sample mass
candidate_oracle: maximum utility over eligible candidates, separately for each utility metric; greedy is outside this candidate pool
comparisons: each policy minus greedy and minus uniform_random; report image-paired mean deltas and per-image win/tie/loss

bootstrap.interval: percentile 2.5 and 97.5; shared row draws across policies and metrics within each group

relative_improvement: compute mean-delta / baseline-mean for RR with positive baseline; signed cosine margins use absolute differences only
quality: selection quality probability and token-limit probability; exact tie expectation
training: no model update or candidate regeneration
